implement.name: Project layout
implement.summary: Modules by domain, thin lib.rs, workspace from the second deployable unit on

implement.name: Domain types
implement.summary: Invalid states unrepresentable — the organising principle of the whole module

implement.name: Errors
implement.summary: Typed errors per layer, Result at the boundaries, no leaky public error type

implement.name: Testing
implement.summary: One test per invariant, not per function; the compiler is the first suite

implement.name: Lints and safety comments
implement.summary: The clippy baseline, and unsafe isolated behind a SAFETY: comment

implement.name: No unwrap/expect in production
implement.summary: Outside tests and declared prototypes, a panic path is a design gap

implement.name: No clone to silence the borrow checker
implement.summary: A defensive clone hides the ownership question rather than answering it

implement.name: No single-implementer traits
implement.summary: A generic trait with one implementer buys indirection and no substitution

implement.name: No Deref as inheritance
implement.summary: Deref is coercion, not a base class — using it as one breaks the reader

review.name: Rust refusals
review.summary: unwrap/expect, defensive clone, single-implementer traits, Deref-as-inheritance

audit.name: Rust audit
audit.summary: Measure an existing crate against these guides, each finding citing the one it breaks
